boundaries.evidence: Passing cover R2 logs show Terrain PREDELETE before EXIT_TREE. Godot 4.7 SceneTree::finalize exits the hierarchy and propagates tree_exited before memdelete(root).
boundaries.discriminator: This packet changes only explicit-free control flow to normal quit with all original components alive. Same map bindings, population, camera and rendered-frame prerequisites.

boundaries.component: Game fallback save and RealmShells worker joins
boundaries.evidence: Game._exit_tree calls finish_fallback. Fallback finish joins current/pending workers and _join clears _thread. RealmShells._exit_tree joins abandoned scene reads. These synchronous exit hooks precede the original Game/world tree-exited markers.
boundaries.remaining_limit: fallback_save_worker also has a PREDELETE last-resort join/write. Source alone does not prove every late object's state, but no retained evidence identifies a nonempty worker after the observed exit callbacks. No save bypass or speculative join removal is justified.
